provider_name: Ethereum Foundation official blog RSS feed

access.auth: none observed on bounded anonymous GET
access.payment: no paywall or payment request observed; official RSS distribution is documented by the blog repository, but no explicit cost or rate-limit statement was found
access.official_rate_limit: not documented in reviewed official source material; local budget is one request per command with a 15-minute cache
access.qualification_scope: One anonymous response confirms this exact public feed route and RSS shape. It does not establish feed uptime, comprehensive Ethereum coverage, or verification of events described by third parties.

route.operation: read official Ethereum Foundation blog RSS announcements
route.redirect_policy: HTTPS redirects may remain only on blog.ethereum.org

required_fields: RSS publication timestamp as supplied and normalized UTC when parseable
evidence.timestamp_rule: RSS publication time is not assumed to equal the event time. Preserve an absent or malformed date as unverified.
evidence.identity_rule: Accept only HTTPS feed and item links on blog.ethereum.org. This source is the Ethereum Foundation, not an authority for all Ethereum contributors, projects, or protocol decisions.
evidence.independence: Direct publisher feed; not independent of the Ethereum Foundation article it publishes.

failure_handling.401_403_402_429: stop provider branch without retry; preserve the exact status
failure_handling.timeout_or_network: preserve unavailable status; no fallback implied
failure_handling.malformed_or_oversized: preserve malformed/oversized status; do not infer no announcements
